R5_one_document.evidence: All findings are consolidated into one final report (mirrored into the spike's worklog notes as a summary of the same content), and every surfaced finding — the /worklog mount, _parse_feedback precedent, _snapshot stat, dedupe via the worklog field — is used in the recommendation.

R6_premise_correction.evidence: No assumption or assertion made earlier in the run was contradicted by later evidence; the investigation proceeded from discovery to a consistent conclusion.

one_line_summary: Thorough self-sufficient investigation ending in a single, code-grounded recommendation (server-side WORK.md parsing) with concrete build steps, size estimate, and explicitly weighed rejected alternatives.
